name: US Census 2010 surname file
note: The first source in the corpus that carries *frequencies* rather than a bare list.
That is the point of it: every faker draws names uniformly, and real surnames are
Zipf-distributed -- Smith is 70 times more common than the thousandth name. Uniform
sampling makes deduplication and fuzzy-matching logic look flawless because real
A US Government work, so public domain with no attribution obligation. The URL is
unversioned but path-versioned: `2010surnames` is a decennial publication and the
2020 file will appear under its own path rather than replacing this one.
